convention: normalized density at fixed nodes; nearest-node assignment, midpoint ties upward

definition.source_density: f(x)=x exp(-x) for x>=0; zero otherwise
definition.quantizer: nearest node; midpoint ties upward; endpoint clipping
definition.label: 12-bit standard binary index j, MSB first
definition.secondary_target: Untruncated continuous Gamma quantized to nearest nodes, with endpoint clipping; cell_pmf is diagnostic, NOT the training target
definition.validation: Nonnegative normalized PMFs; all4096 node/index roundtrips passed
